response.rationale: The item is defective (never powered on since delivery) and is not final sale. RET-020 (priority 90) applies and allows return of defective items regardless of the standard window, overriding RET-008 which would otherwise make the return ineligible at 63 days. No final-sale (RET-012) or fraud-hold (RET-051) conditions are true. Category is 'home', so electronics rules do not apply.
